verdict.rationale: Asana markets built-in AI capabilities—AI Teammates, AI Studio automations, and 'Asana Dash: Your AI Chief of Staff'—that align with delegating tasks to an in-product assistant, but these are vendor marketing lines rather than detailed docs or hands-on accounts of task delegation workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of delegating tasks to the assistant, detailed documentation of how delegation works, and community confirmation of real-world use.
